verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's live llms.txt calls it 'the most trusted open source password manager'. Community threads confirm it relicensed back to a Free/Open license after the SDK controversy, and users choose it because its clients are open source. A runtime probe confirms at least one first-party repo (bitwarden/mcp-server) is published under GPL-3.0. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the main client/server repositories and their specific licenses, and first-party docs describing the licensing of core components such as the SDK.
